auth_note: Docs say an OpenReview account (username and password) is needed to use the API; sign-up is self-serve by email. Anonymous probe got a 403 challenge page from the sandbox.
probe_observation: Probe returned JSON error ChallengeRequiredError 'Challenge verification required' with status 403 and a challengeUrl on openreview.net, so no data was returned to the sandbox.

evidence.quote: You need an OpenReview account to use the API. You authenticate with the same username and password you use on the website
Enter an email address and click the "Sign Up" button. You'll be prompted to create a password.

not_established: Whether sign-up is free is not stated in captured pages (cost not established); signup page notes public-email domains can take up to 2 weeks to activate. Rate limit: meta.json shows response headers ratelimit-policy 180;w=60 on the challenge response, but no captured docs page states a limit. Data license not found in docs/OpenAPI captured. No bulk dump documented in captured pages (docs index and OpenAPI searched). Probe is a bot challenge (403), so anonymous data access was not shown; the API data itself was not seen from this sandbox.
